top_signals.title: TA Services acquires 2 Texas cross-border carriers, adds 133 trucks
top_signals.summary:
TA Services has acquired Carmen Pacheco Transportation and Interload Forwarding, adding 133 trucks and more than 550,000 square feet of warehousing along the U.S.-Mexico border.

The post TA Services acquires 2 Texas cross-border carriers, adds 133 trucks appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Francis Halzen wins 2026 Nobel Prize in physics
top_signals.summary: Among past laureates are some of the most celebrated figures in science, including Albert Einstein, Marie and Pierre Curie, Max Planck and Niels Bohr.
